title: Script downloads or executes remote content insecurely

messages.businessImpact: Code is fetched over an unencrypted connection or from a location outside the organisation's control, then run with system rights on managed devices.
remediation: Move the content to a location the organisation controls and fetch it over HTTPS.
Verify a hash or signature before executing anything downloaded.
messages.cannotSee: What the script fetches is not read, only that it fetches over plain HTTP or runs what it downloads. A download from a server inside the organisation over a network nobody else reaches carries less risk than the same line pointing at the internet, and this cannot tell them apart. A script whose content this run could not read is passed over rather than cleared, and a script Microsoft publishes is passed over too.
